claim: A state-free REL_RATIO pulse representation transfers across chemistries/groups.
safe_wording: The state-free relative pulse representation retained cross-domain performance while removing the SOCR/SOE ambiguity.
do_not_say: SOCR and SOE are physically equivalent.

claim: Few-shot target adaptation materially improves SOH prediction.
evidence: Internal MAE 8.268->3.006 pp; external 8.720->3.468 pp; paired Wilcoxon p=0.000977 internal and p=0.000977 external.
safe_wording: Few-shot target adaptation consistently reduced SOH error in both internal chemistry-shift and overlap-excluded cross-dataset evaluation.
do_not_say: Few-shot adaptation guarantees accurate performance on any unseen battery.

claim: Target-aware conformal calibration recovers approximately nominal 90% coverage.
safe_wording: With target-aware calibration at K=20, empirical coverage approached the nominal 90% level.
do_not_say: The conformal interval is universally valid under arbitrary domain shift.

claim: OOD detection identifies held-out chemistry shift.
evidence: Day14 Mahalanobis/KNN AUROC=1.0 in the tested held-out chemistry design.
safe_wording: OOD scores strongly separated the tested held-out chemistry domains from source domains.
do_not_say: OOD score universally predicts SOH error or all real-world distribution shifts.

evidence: 170 overlapping raw IDs were excluded; 539 target cells remained.

claim: The uncertainty-aware screening layer reduces unsafe reuse decisions.
evidence: Day16 observed false-safe rate=0.002357; Day19 protocol-locked sensitivity observed 0 false-safe rows at 20 and 30 calibration cells in the tested repeats.
safe_wording: The conservative interval-based policy routed most ambiguous cells to additional diagnostics and showed low observed false-safe rates in the tested repeated-resampling design.
do_not_say: The screening system is deployment-certified or zero-risk.

claim: Increasing target calibration size improves safety.
evidence: 10-cal: false-safe=0.002357, PICP=0.9093; 20-cal: false-safe=0.000000, PICP=0.9127; 30-cal: false-safe=0.000000, PICP=0.8902.
safe_wording: Larger calibration sets removed observed true false-safe events in this protocol-locked sensitivity analysis, but safety, coverage, interval width, and decisiveness did not improve monotonically.
do_not_say: More calibration cells always improve performance.

claim: ECM-inspired pulse physics features provide a universal transferable representation.
evidence: Day12 showed PHYSICS and REL_PLUS_PHYSICS were worse overall than REL_RATIO.
safe_wording: ECM-inspired surrogates provided chemistry-specific interpretability and limited domain-specific gains, but were not the best universal predictor.
do_not_say: Physics surrogate features universally improve cross-domain SOH prediction.

claim: A fitted electrical 1RC/2RC Digital Twin has been validated.
evidence: Day09 found no pulse/relaxation excitation in LFP23 for defensible 2RC identification; Day10-11 became SOC-label provenance evidence; Day12 used ECM-inspired surrogates only.
safe_wording: The present computational evidence is physics-guided / pulse-physics-informed, not a validated electrical 2RC Digital Twin.

claim: The current computational study alone supports 'Digital-Twin-Assisted' in the title.
evidence: No validated electrical 1RC/2RC or independent state-twin evidence currently exists.
safe_wording: Remove 'Digital-Twin-Assisted' from the current paper title unless a separate raw pulse/HPPC or Chroma-based DT identification/validation stage is added.
do_not_say: Digital-Twin-Assisted based only on U1-U21 surrogate features.

claim: The study is fully experimentally validated.
